$comment: Focus-bracket frame cycle — one frame, static decode + bench anchor. Derived from cpapp-b.bin fw 4.00 (Inv. 1). Offsets are file offsets; VA = file + 0x108000. Constants byte-verified. Durations in VD fields (1 field = 16.6833 ms) except stage 0 which is in-stage (no field cost).

stages.name: Frame kick
stages.entry: Previous frame's readout done; still-execute pipeline enters capture-init stage (Stg>CapInit / Stg>CapInitLv)
stages.exit: Bracket request written, kick flag set, event emitted (handler sets RAM 0x0158829A)

stages.name: FSM state 0 — compute target + send MOVE_FC_A
stages.entry: Kick consumed; lens context present; lens idle/ready
stages.exit: MOVE_FC_A (cmd 0x43) queued to lens; FSM -> state 1
stages.detail: target = clamp(start_pos +/- (step_table[idx] * (lens_ctx[0xE]>>1)) >> 6); step_table at file 0x27D384 = {32,42,53,64,74,85,96,106,117,128}; drive profile fixed 0; first move of sequence sets sequence-start bit

stages.name: FSM state 1 — lens travel wait
stages.duration_type: lens physics (bench-derived residual; lens- and step-width-dependent)
stages.exit: All four move-done sub-checks pass (or 60-field abort cap -> state 4)
stages.detail: polled once per VD field via camera-generic move-done gate: !0x019CC125 AND cmd-0x1D completion bit (7x0xC table at RAM 0x01109114, byte +5) AND cmd-0x43 move-state (else encoder convergence within +/-126 units) AND 0x019CC126==0. Same gate the AF path uses.

stages.name: FSM state 2 — fixed settle + focus-window validation
stages.exit: Settle counter hits 4, then lens position validated inside requested window (else retry <=12 attempts, then abort -> state 4)
stages.detail: THE camera-side time constant. One-byte patchable (cmp r0,#4 -> cmp r0,#N). Trimming risks window-check retries and soft frames; buys <=2-3 fields.

stages.name: FSM state 3 — parked; exposure + readout
stages.duration_type: imaging pipeline (equals burst frame cost; bench-anchored)
stages.entry: FSM parks in state 3 (move done, settled, window validated)
stages.exit: Exposure + readout complete; stage pipeline advances to next frame's capture-init
stages.detail: FSM state-3 body is empty; the exposure arms on the EC_ExpWait/SetupCap path (kick was issued at frame start). Next kick arrives from next frame's capture-init.

totals.note_body_fixed: 1 (send) + 1 (state-1 min poll) + 4 (settle) — even an instant lens could not beat ~15 fields/frame for this drive profile
totals.serialization: fully serial; move cycle (states 0-2, ~11 fields) strictly precedes imaging (state 3, ~9 fields); kick issued from next frame's capture-init; no overlap path exists in the code
